page: Microsoft Azure EC2ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECadsv6 family. It is equipped with 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

For local storage, the EC2ads_v6 includes a bundled 77 GB local SSD. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the 8.0 GB of memory per core, this instance offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads relative to its low vCPU count. This makes it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads requiring more memory than compute power, such as small-scale relational databases, caching layers, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
